basis: NN’s March 10, 2022 release establishes that Q4 2021 consolidated GAAP net sales were $110,379,000, down 7.27% from $119,028,000 in Q4 2020 and below the $113,076,600 cutoff. Both figures come directly from the same three-month GAAP table, with Life Sciences classified as discontinued operations. March 10 is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. The onset date remains unresolved because NN announced a public September 2021 investor presentation whose slides I could not verify.

coverage.detail: August 5 Q2 release reported $123.2 million in quarterly net sales and announced the August 6 call. It supplied no consolidated Q4 sales range.

The Q2 presentation discussed second-half demand by segment. Mobile Solutions expected volume consistent with the first half, conditional on partial recovery from the chip shortage. Power Solutions expected second-half demand growth of 3%–7% year over year. Neither established a Q4 consolidated sales ceiling.

NN’s September 1 notice said its Lake Street presentation would be publicly available before the September 14 market open. The notice gave no Q4 sales figure. I located a subsequent slideshow listing but could not read the underlying slides to rule out earlier quarter-specific guidance.
The November 4 Q3 release reported $117.2 million of Q3 net sales, up 3.1%. It discussed semiconductor shortages but gave no numeric Q4 consolidated sales outlook.

In the presentation accompanying the November 5 call, slide 13 anticipated continued soft Q4 Mobile Solutions demand. Slide 14 projected approximately 3% year-over-year Q4 demand growth for Power Solutions. Slide 15 quantified cash flows. Management also said on the call that formal revenue guidance remained suspended. These disclosures supplied no consolidated Q4 sales ceiling.

The issuer’s intervening release archive includes two February 24 announcements. One concerned closure of the Taunton facility within Power Solutions. The other scheduled the Q4 results release for March 10 after market close. Neither disclosed preliminary Q4 consolidated sales.
The March 4 exhibit announced a term-loan covenant amendment for 2022–2023. Management discussed expected profitability in 2022 and supplied no Q4 2021 consolidated sales estimate.
The March 10 actual-results release explicitly compares the three months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020. Its consolidated GAAP net sales row gives 110,379 and 119,028 in thousands of dollars.

publication_date_evidence: NN’s investor-relations page timestamps the verified actual-results release March 10, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. EST. The SEC exhibit carries the same dateline. The earnings call followed on March 11.
